source: Come on. Let's not keep him waiting. I don't want him to see us talking to each other too much - he might get suspicious.
You don't want to know how it went?
Yeah, you're right. Let's go.
Well I can. That's an engine coming down the wasteland. Sounds like our visitor is early. Is everything ready? We all set?
Yeah. I think so.
So it would seem. We'll see if it bites us in the ass.
Anything new on your end?
I think I'd like your help with him. He's a hard man to deal with one on one.
What's done is done, though. We'll see if it bites us in the ass.
Anything new on your end?
I think I'd like your help with him. He's a hard man to deal with one on one.
Likewise.
Anything new on your end?
I think I'd like your help with him. He's a hard man to deal with one on one.
Likewise, Eli. Let's hope we come out of this stronger than before.
Anything new on your end?
I think I'd like your help with him. He's a hard man to deal with one on one.
Yes, actually. I've been watching him carefully as the two of you have been talking, and I think I've spotted something...pretty serious.
Which was?
Get to the point.
That might be true, but I think I can be plenty useful here. I've been watching him carefully as we talk - as you're distracting him with conversation.
And did you see anything?
Get to the point.
He's armed, Eli. I wasn't sure at first, but he's got a gun under that jacket.
That's not good.
He's traveling on his own. I'm not surprised.
What do you think that means?
I thought the same, but I don't like the fact that he's concealing it. I had to check a few times to make sure.
(CYNIC) Well, now we know for certain that he's dangerous.
(IDEALIST) I mean, there's a chance he hides it as to not scare or worry us.
(REALIST) Regardless of reason, it's good to know. I'm thankful you spotted it.
Well, I understand needing one out here - self-defense and all that - but I don't like the fact that it's so concealed. I had to check a couple times to make sure.
(CYNIC) Well, now we know for certain that he's dangerous.
(IDEALIST) I mean, there's a chance he hides it as to not scare or worry us.
(REALIST) Regardless of reason, it's good to know. I'm thankful you spotted it.
It's not. I understand needing one out here - self-defense and all that - but I don't like the fact that it's so concealed. I had to check a couple times to make sure.
(CYNIC) Well, now we know for certain that he's dangerous.
(IDEALIST) I mean, there's a chance he hides it as to not scare or worry us.
(REALIST) Regardless of reason, it's good to know. I'm thankful you spotted it.
I reckon you're right. Is everything in order? We all set?
Yeah. I think so.
I'm really not sure.
What we don't know is whether or not he considers us a threat, Eli. I keep saying it, but we have to be careful. Do you think he considers us a threat?
Why do you ask?
I don't think so.
I have no clue. I can't read him.
Probably, yes.

Maybe, but in that case he might as well have left it in the car, right? Of course, we could get to it if it was in the car, so either he wants to be armed, or just make sure no one else has it. We need to look at the worst case scenario, Eli. Does he consider us a threat?
Why do you ask?
I don't think so.
I have no clue. I can't read him.
Probably, yes.
So am I, but I can't say I'm entirely surprised. Remember what I said about the other expeditions? This seems like a likely explanation. Tell me, Eli - does he consider us a threat?
Why do you ask?
I don't think so.
I have no clue. I can't read him.
Probably, yes.
I need you to be sure, Eli. Yes or no.
I'm sure. He thinks we're harmless.
It's...possible, I suppose.
That doesn't leave us much to go on. Listen, Eli, we might need to consider what we do if he turns that gun on us.
We don't. Trust me, alright? I've got this.
I'm sure I can ease his mind. Give me another shot.
Do you have a plan?
Then we might need to take some kinds of precautions.
You're worrying too much. I can handle this.
Do you have a plan?
Because regardless of whether he believes our story or not, he may consider us harmless or dangerous. If the latter, there's no telling how he'll act, no matter how much he believes us.
I don't think our visitor considers us a threat.
Unfortunately, I have no clue what he thinks of us.
I'm pretty sure he's not taking chances, and considers us a threat no matter what.
Alright. You remember what we're going to tell him?
Yes. The Artifact is too dangerous to be brought into the City. We should stay here to conduct experiments in a safe location.
Yes. The Artifact died during the past few days, and is useless to both us and HQ.
Yes. The Artifact is highly complex, needs a state-of-the-art lab, and we're the only ones that can safely conduct experiments on it.
...Refresh my memory, if you don't mind.
Possibly. But it's not something I would do without you being on the same page. Are you?
If this involves taking any risks that might...endanger us? Then no.
I need to know what the plan is before I can say that, Jorge.
Always.
I'm not so sure, Eli. Are you certain?
Yes. I am.
[Say nothing]

Alright. Well, in that case...I'll keep watching you two. He's going to want to see the Artifact next, I'm sure. Make sure you convince him of whatever you tell him, alright? We can't afford him jumping to his own conclusions.
You do that. I'll go join him.
Will you be alright here?

Fine. You or me would be no match for a man with a gun. The two of us, together, however...well, there's at least a fighting chance. Of course, there's also the possibility that one of us will get hurt.
We can't do that, Jorge. It's too dangerous.
Are you saying we could try to take him down?
Yes or no, Eli.
I won't agree to something you refuse to share with me, Jorge.
...Fine. Yes.
Good luck. Don't mess this up.
[Leave]
I'll be right back.
I'll be nervous, that's for sure,  but considering the circumstances, I'll take it. Go join him, alright? And good luck.
[Leave]
You too.

Alright. You or me, on our own, would be no match for a man with a gun. The two of us, however...well, there's at least a fighting chance. Of course, there's also the possibility that one of us will get hurt.
Are you saying we could try to take him down?
That's a risk I'd be willing to take.
And while we're out here, we figure out what exactly this thing is - as well as what HQ's intentions are.
Think it will work?
Sounds good. What else?
We could try, yes. There's no telling if it would work, but I can certainly tell you that I'd rather go down trying to wrestle a gun out of someone's hand than do nothing and stare down the barrel.
That doesn't seem like the safest idea, Jorge.
...I'm not sure about this.
Same.
Good. I'm not entirely sure how, but once you two come back, let's talk, all of us. When there's a chance, either one of us gives the signal, and we both jump him.
Let's hope it doesn't come to that.
Will do.
Do you have a better idea?
You could sneak up on him.
Let me try to talk to him. I'm confident I can figure this out.
...No, you're right. It's the only way.
If you think you can, sure. Give it a shot- fighting could be our backup plan. If you see an opening, give me the signal, and we jump him.
Let's hope it doesn't come to that.
Will do.

...Have you seen me, man? I'm not exactly the stealthiest guy around. Look, if you want to try something else, you can - fighting could be our backup plan. If you see an opening, give me the signal, and we jump him.
Let's hope it doesn't come to that.
Will do.
Yeah. It's going to be incredibly risky, no matter what. If you make the call, you need to be completely certain we can do it, alright?
Don't worry. I'll make sure.
I'm not sure I'll ever be completely certain. You just need to go when I say go.
Only when you're ready. When you think we can do it. I need you to be completely certain before we make a move, alright? Otherwise it's not going to end well for either of us.
Don't worry. I'll make sure.
I'm not sure I'll ever be completely certain. You just need to go when I say go.
Right. I'd rather risk my credibility than my life anyway. If we sell it well, who knows - maybe we get a ride back to the City.
Think it will work?
Sounds good. What else?
Alright. Now go on - he was heading towards the Artifact. I definitely don't want him to spend much time with that thing alone. I'll be here.
Yeah. I'm going.
Will you be alright?
I suppose so. Now go on - he was heading towards the Artifact. I definitely don't want him to spend much time with that thing alone. I'll be here.
Yeah. I'm going.
Will you be alright?
I can't do it without you, Eli. I'd just hate if we go down without a fight.
We don't go down. I promise.
Trust me, Jorge. I don't like it either.
Yeah. I think that's making me even more tense. Thanks for going along with it, though. If he does something, at least we will have tried.
Let's just hope it doesn't come to that. I'll be right back.
Yeah. Just stay calm.
I desperately do, but I don't think we have time to chat right now.
[Whisper] Be ready for the signal.
[Whisper] Don't try anything. Please.
Just stay calm, alright?
You're right. Lets' go.
I will be. Now come on. Let's go.
[Leave]
I won't. Not without you helping me. Now come on, man. He's watching us.
[Leave]
I'll do my best, man. Now come on - he's watching us. We should join him by the car.
[Leave]
Exactly. We're the heads of research on this. Indispensible. Which, I guess, is true.
Think it will work?
Sounds good. What else?

We're telling them the Artifact is highly volatile. Bringing it into the City is an unreasonable risk - it's better off out here, where the two of us can keep conducting experiments. Possibly with a small team. Got it?
Think it will work?
Yeah. Anything else?
We're telling them we messed up. The Artifact's dead, and there's nothing we or HQ can do about it. We're...incompetent, perhaps. Got it?
Think it will work?
Yeah. Anything else?
We, the two of us, are the sole experts when it comes to the Artifact. We'll need equipment and a safe lab in the City to work on it. Got it?
Think it will work?
Yeah. Anything else?
It has to. Can't afford not to believe in it now. Speaking of - you sure you got everything ready?
...I hope so.
Yeah. I'm certain.
Let's go through everything, step by step.
Anything to report?
We just went over the research.
He went ahead to check the research while I came over to talk to you.
How are you holding up?
Nothing else. I'll go join our visitor.
We took care of most of the preparations yesterday. As long as we were thorough, we should be fine.
...I hope so.
Don't worry. I was very thorough.
Let's go through everything, just in case.
Well, you better get it together. We get one shot at this, so we better hit the bullseye. You remember our story?
Yes. The Artifact is too dangerous to be brought into the City. We should stay here to conduct experiments in a safe location.
Yes. The Artifact died during the past few days, and is useless to both us and HQ.
Yes. The Artifact is highly complex, needs a state-of-the-art lab, and we're the only ones that can safely conduct experiments on it.
...Refresh my memory, if you don't mind.
Right - we got the story. How's the Artifact looking?
Pacified. Looked still and docile moments ago.
Terrifying. Agitating it yesterday didn't exactly score me any points with it.
Same as usual. Left it alone last night.
If that's what you think is needed, then sure. Just remember to keep that in mind for the rest of the visit.
I'll do my best.
Yeah. You feeling alright?
Are you planning on staying back here?
Not exactly, he...kind of just put me in that position and made me agree. He's got a way with words, Eli. Be careful with him.
It's fine, honestly. You were the one who pushed for the experiments, so it just makes sense.
...Didn't we say you were the one who couldn't wait to get the experiments going?
Try not to worry, Jorge.
I'll do my best.
Alright, alright - what about our logged research?
Had to rip some pages out of it, but I hope it makes our story more believable.
Untouched. Everything is in there.
Then let's hope that's enough. How about our research ledger? What's the status there?
Had to rip some pages out of it, but I hope it makes our story more believable.
Untouched. Everything is in there.
Maybe it'll scare our visitor off. How about our logged research? What's the status there again?
Had to rip some pages out of it, but I hope it makes our story more believable.
Untouched. Everything is in there.
I hope so too. I trust you were thorough with that, Eli. Lastly, he's going to want to see our journals. How are they looking?
Same - had to do a bit of light censoring.
They're intact. Everything's in there.
Let's see where honesty gets us, then. Lastly, he's going to want to see our journals. How are they looking?
Same - had to do a bit of light censoring.
They're intact. Everything's in there.
Well? How did it go? What's the read on this guy?
(IDEALIST) I think it's going alright so far.
(REALIST) We won't know for a bit. He's not letting much on.
(CYNIC) I don't think he trusts a word I say. Makes you wonder what they told him back at HQ.
He's asking a lot of questions. A lot of them don't seem relevant.
He seems like a prick to me.
He seems alright. I think he's just doing his job.
I'd rather have empty journals than something that contradicts what we tell him. Did you do today's entry yet?
Not yet.
Do we need one?
As long as what's there doesn't incriminate us, we'll be fine. I hope. Did you do today's entry yet?
Not yet.
Do we need one?
Don't let me keep you, Eli. Stay with our guest. I don't like him being left alone in the camp for too long.
I'm going.
Alright - I think I hear that car getting closer. You fill that in, and I'll go do some light meet and greet. Distract him. Sound good?
Yeah. Good luck, Jorge.
I'm not sure about this, Jorge.
...What should I write?

Protocol is protocol, Eli. Would look bad or even suspicious if we don't put anything in there. Also, I...wait, I think I hear that car getting closer. You take care of the journal entry, I'll go distract him. Sound good?
Yeah. Good luck, Jorge.
I don't know, Jorge. Maybe it's better to leave it empty.
...What should I write?
Yeah. We've got this. I hope.
I hope so too.
We better.
Come on, Jorge. Move it!
Basics. Temperature, day planning - listen, we could even add something in there to sell our story even more.
Alright - I'll see what I can think of. Get going, alright?
Got it. Good luck out there, Jorge. We've got this.
Like what?

If you're worried, just put in some basic info. "Visit today, temperature is so-and-so, blah-blah." Doesn't have to be anything substantial - or, you could even write something that makes our story seem more credible. Just make sure there's something there.
Alright. I'll do it. Good luck out there.
Remember to breathe, Jorge. We've got this.
More credible? Like what?
I don't know! I've got a stranger to distract, Eli. You'll think of something. Get to it!
I'll see what I can think of.
Breathe, Jorge. We've got this.
Shit. Yeah, you're right. Listen - just spin it as something different. You know, maybe I nagged you about it. Convinced you to do it. I don't know, man. You'll figure something out.
I hope so.
Try not to worry about it. Maybe he won't even notice.
You're staying back here?
I don't like how ready he was to invite himself into the tent. Don't let him rummage around in there on his own. Keep an eye on him, Eli.
We need to get our stories straight. I should be the head scientist.
Are you alright with me saying I'm the boss around here?
He seemed a little weird about us saying we decide things together.
...You told him you were my boss?
I'm on it.
You're just going to stay here?
I don't know, Eli. This guy looks sharp. Sharper than we'd like him to be. Just watch what you say, alright? Check in with me whenever you have the time. I want to know what's going on.
Alright. Wish me luck.
You're staying here?
Yeah. Better for him to have a single source of information. That way we don't mix up our stories or contradict each other.
Alright. Wish me luck.
What are you going to do?
I'm going to have a look around his car. See what we're dealing with.
Alright. I'll get back to him.
Be careful, Jorge.
You think so? I'm glad to hear it, but don't let your guard down just yet. He's...smiling a lot. I'm not sure I like that. In fact, I definitely don't.
He seemed happy to talk to me in private.
He's definitely trying to be friendly. He's asking a lot of questions about us.
Like what, exactly? This guy is tricky, Eli. I get the feeling he's trying to trip us up.
He seemed happy to talk to me in private.
He's asking about us. A lot.
I know. He just...cornered me, somehow. I didn't say I was the boss, he just insinuated it and spun me into his story. He's got a way with words, Eli. Be careful with him.
I'll do my best.
Try to keep your cool, Jorge. We've got this.
Are you going to stay here?

Focus, man - I was the one who pushed for the experiments. It only makes sense for me to be the head scientist. Little things like this are going to matter. Be careful with him, Eli. He's got a way with words.
I'll do my best.
Are you worried?
Are you staying here?
I was thinking that too. We just need to remember to keep that story straight for the rest of the visit. I'm sure you can do it, Eli. You'll figure something out.
I'll do my best.
What do you think so far?
Me? I'll figure something out?
No joke. Anyone driving a flashy car like that out into the wasteland has got to either have a screw loose or really care about appearances.. What's he been saying?
He seemed happy to talk to me in private.
He's asking about us. A lot.

There's always a lead scientist, man. He's probably used to that by now, so anything other than that is, well, possibly suspicious. Might not have been the best thing to say, but hey, that's what we're sticking with now.
You're worried, then?
Yeah. I better follow him.
Are you going to stay back here?
...Do you hear that?
(CYNIC) Yeah. That's the sound of impending doom.
(IDEALIST) Sounds like our ride's here, huh?
(REALIST) That'll be our visitor, I suppose.
...Is that a car?
No, I can't hear anything.

I don't like it. Doesn't feel honest, but I'm not sure that's what I expected from HQ after how they've been acting. He's an awful lot friendlier than the usual radio operator, that's for sure. Not sure I like it.
He seemed happy to talk to me in private.
Yeah, he's taking quite an interest in the two of us. Asking personal questions.

They send one car with a single driver out to see both of us, Eli. I wouldn't doubt they told him everything they know - and even if they don't know everything, I figure he's here to connect the remaining dots.
He seemed happy to talk to me in private.
I get the feeling he's trying to scope us out. Get to know us.
I'm more concerned about what exactly his job is. What's he been saying?
He seemed happy to talk to me in private.
He's asking about us. A lot.
...So what did you tell him, exactly?
All sorts of things. He just made conversation about anything he saw.
We talked a little bit about you.
We talked about the journal entries.
No kidding. I suppose that's part of his job, after all.
He seems very unpredictable - at least hard to follow. He'll be friendly and then suddenly drop something worrying into conversation like it's nothing.
He's certainly doing his best to keep us on our toes.
And he's very good at it, to be honest. I can barely keep up.
You did, huh? Anything you told him, you should tell me.
I told him about your background.
He knows you're a believer.
He asked what you're like to work with.
And? Was he suspicious?
He certainly asked about the missing entries.
Not suspicious, per se - more inquisitive.

You don't think you just might have been very convincing? Come on, Eli - I need you to keep your spirits up. You're not exactly the most optimistic person I know...shit, you might be the least optimistic person I know. I need you on top of this. Can I count on you?
I hope so.
Can I count on you?
I'm not sure.

Yeah? He doesn't seem very blue collar to me - probably moves in similar circles as you. Listen, if he tries to steer the conversation into that direction again, do me a favor and try to avoid it, alright? I don't like him knowing much about me.
I'll do my best, but he just...asks the right questions.
Or us, for that matter.
I don't want him to know anything about me neither.
...Is that relevant? Listen, Eli - if he tries to shift the conversation to anything except our work, he's fishing. I don't know what for, but I don't like it.
I know what I'm doing, Jorge.
Sorry, Jorge. Won't happen again.
I don't like it either.
Might be onto something there, bud. How is everything? Ready? We all set?
Yeah. I think so.
Don't think I'd ever be ready for this.
A reasonable enough ask, I suppose. Listen, Eli - and I don't mean this in a bad way - I trust you to talk to him. Just make sure we stick to the plan.
You got it.
I'll try. He's intimidating, in a strange way.
I know what I'm doing, Jorge. You don't need to tell me.
Right. Don't let him talk over or around you. Keep it focused. Don't let him try anything, and...don't try anything yourself.
...Hold on, what's that supposed to mean?
I know what I'm doing.
Don't worry, Jorge. I'll be careful.
You seem a decent enough guy, Eli. Especially the past couple days. But I'm just...you know people like this better than me. How well, I'm not sure. Just remember that we're supposed to be a team.
(CYNIC) Are you saying you're worried I'm going to betray you?
(IDEALIST) You're worried he's trying to play us against each other?
(REALIST) You know, there's a chance he doesn't see it that way.
Whatever you say.
Don't worry, Jorge. I'm keeping it under control.
Worried? Not exactly. I'm just being cautious. Don't take it personally.
...I'll try.
No offense taken.
Sure. How are you doing back here?
Something like that. I wouldn't put it past him. I hope I can count on you, too.
You can. Don't worry.
...Okay, sure.
How about you? What are you up to?
I'm certain of it. Don't trust him, Eli. Stick to the plan. Don't try anything fancy. If you do, run it by me first.
I know what I'm doing.
Of course.
Speaking of running by you, what are you up to?
Shit. What did you tell him?
(CYNIC) Whatever I could think of. Not sure it convinced him.
(IDEALIST) I did my best to cover it up. I think it went fairly well.
(REALIST) I stuck to our story as well as I could. I'm not sure how much of it he believes.
Well as far as I know, everything you've written is still in there. Said it before, Eli - we'll see if honesty counts for anything. What did he say, then?
(CYNIC) He pretended to be understanding. Like everything was in order.
(IDEALIST) He was very understanding. I think he believes we're being honest with him.
(REALIST) He's being nice. Too nice, almost.

Come on, Eli. You need to focus up. Keep on top of this, or things are just going to get worse. You only get one shot at convincing this guy that our plan is sound, and I can't have you being a self-resigned pessimist about it.
I'll try harder. How's that?
But I am a self-resigned pessimist, Jorge.
I just don't see this ending well.
Good man, Eli, good man! Keep that up, alright? Our story needs to be bulletproof for this plan to work. I can count on you, right?
Of course.
Can I count on you?
...I'm doing my best, but I'm a little worried, to be frank.
Real funny, Eli. He is early, though. I wonder if that means anything. Doesn't matter - is everything ready? We all set?
Yeah. I think so.
...Honestly, even I'm having some trouble staying optimistic about this.
Like I said, man. Be careful. He'll twist words around. Shit, I only spoke to him for a moment, and he had me agreeing that I was the boss. You need to do better than me, alright? Can I count on you?
Of course.
Can I count on you?
...I worry, Jorge.
It better have. We get only one shot at this, and I'm putting my faith in you. Can I count on you, Eli?
Of course.
A little less pressure would be nice.
I'll be honest - I'm worried, Jorge.
Well, keep at it. Consistency is key, Eli. This guy seems like someone who sniffs out discrepancies like a private eye. You need to be convincing. Can I count on you for that?
Of course.
I'm not a great liar, Jorge.
No pressure, huh?
Good. Now get back in there - him creeping around by himself is making me nervous.
Sure. How are things on your end?
I'm on it.
I checked the car while you were in the tent. Back seat is full of equipment - containers, safety pods, the works.
And? What else?
And the front?
Sounds like he's prepared to take the Artifact with him.
Doesn't matter. You don't have a choice - we don't have a choice. It's all or nothing. Now come on, get back to him. I don't like him creeping around the camp on his own.
Sure. How are things on your end?
On it.
Nothing I could see. Just two empty seats and a mess in the back.
We can't worry about that for now. Stay focused.
That's worrying.
What are you trying to say, Jorge?
See what else you can find. I'll keep him busy.
The passenger seat is empty. So is the driver's.
We can't worry about that for now. Stay focused.
That's worrying.
What are you trying to say, Jorge?
See what else you can find. I'll keep him busy.
My thoughts exactly. I didn't check the trunk, but there's no more room in the back. Just two empty seats in the front.
We can't worry about that for now. Stay focused.
That's worrying.
What are you trying to say, Jorge?
See what else you can find. I'll keep him busy.
Yeah. I'll see what else I can find. You get back to him, alright? I don't want him touching anything without you there.
I'm on it.
Too right. He's early. Is everything ready? We all set?
Yeah. I think so.
It is. Just focus on keeping him distracted, alright? I'll see what else I can find.
I'm on it.
Well, either this guy is disorganized, or he's expecting only one passenger. Or none, even. Keep him distracted, alright? I'll see what else I can find.
On it.
...Why? Is the story not holding up? I told you he was tricky, Eli. The man ducks and weaves through explanations and excuses like a boxer or something.
Yeah, I don't like him. He made a few comments that almost sounded like threats.
It's like he's trying to keep me nervous. Like he enjoys it.
I worry I can't keep up with him, Jorge.
I'm...tense. I'm sure you are, too.
Don't try anything, Jorge. I beg of you.
Don't worry, I haven't forgot our plan. I'll make the signal if I have to.
Yeah. I better go keep an eye on our visitor. Stay calm.
Figured he'd want to see that. How did it go?
I think he's buying it.
He's definitely suspicious of us.
He doesn't believe a word I say, Jorge.
Is that so? I hope you're right, Eli, and if that's the case, well...good work. If you don't mind, though, I'm not done holding my breath.
Fair enough. He seems unpredictable - makes worrying comments every once in a while.
I think he's trying to keep me - us - on our toes.
Yeah, I worry I can't keep up with him.
Threats? Yeah, I got the same impression. He does enjoy it, Eli. What else did he ask about?
He asked how we get along.
He asked me if we trust each other, I think.
You're going to have to. Did he ask about anything other than the research?
Our relationship out here.
Yes, whether or not we trust each other.
What do you mean?
I think he's trying to create friction between us. He's asking if we trust each other.
I think he's stuck on who's boss - he asked how we get along.
...Are you out of your mind? What was that about? Do you not remember the story?! Are you trying to set me up or something?
...I'm sorry, Jorge, I panicked.
[Shrug]
No, Jorge. I just made a mistake.
Come on, Eli. Don't keep him waiting.
Don't worry, I'm going.
...And what did you tell him?
That we're strictly colleagues, and nothing matters outside of the work.
That we're friends, and that we trust each other. Obviously.
The truth - we haven't necessarily been friends, but we have to depend on each other.
